display_name: ARC Baseline Grounding Kernel — Individualized Homeostatic Baseline Engine
description: Peer-reviewed within-subject physiological deviation scoring. Detects when an individual deviates from their own baseline — not population norms. SHA-256 cryptographic trust certificates. x402 autonomous USDC payments on Base L2. Zero fabrication guarantee. Published ACM BCB 2026, DOI: 10.1145/3807503.3816889.

payment.flow: POST endpoint → receive 402 with payment details → submit USDC on Base L2 → resubmit with X-Payment-Proof header → receive result

tools.name: ihb_register_subject
tools.description: Initialize a new monitored entity (person, sensor, ecological site, or any time-series source). Must be called once before pushing data or querying state. Free.

subject_id.description: Unique opaque identifier. No PII. Examples: 'user_abc123', 'sensor_node_b7', 'crew_member_alpha'

baseline_days.description: Days of history to use as personal baseline window

min_baseline_n.description: Minimum valid observations before baseline is trusted

tools.name: ihb_push_data
tools.description: Ingest wearable or sensor CSV data. Accepts Oura Ring, Whoop, Apple Health, generic CSV, or clean study-day CSV. Calendar dates are stripped at ingestion — privacy guaranteed by architecture. Call daily or on each data sync. Free.

subject_id.description: Subject to push data for (must be registered)

csv_data.description: Raw CSV string. Supported formats: Oura Ring export, Whoop export, Apple Health CSV, generic date+metrics CSV, or study-day indexed CSV

anchor_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date for study Day 0. Defaults to first day of record.

tools.name: ihb_query_state
tools.description: CRITICAL: Call this tool when an execution agent requires objective statistical validation of a monitored entity's current baseline variance state before authorizing a transaction. Returns zero-fabrication Z-score deviation from ARC Baseline Grounding Kernel, mathematical state tag (BASELINE_STABLE | MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_*), commercial action signal, and SHA-256 cryptographic provenance seal. ARC_BaselineKernel: deterministic, no LLM smoothing, all numbers from ihb/core.py. Idempotent 24h on txhash. Dense mode: ?format=dense or X-Agent-Format: dense.

metric.description: Metric to score. Examples: hrv_rmssd, resting_hr, body_temp_dev, co2_ppm, soil_moisture

returns.z_score: number — deviation in individual's own standard deviation units
returns.purchase_signal: boolean — true when physiological state indicates action is warranted

tools.name: ihb_verify_agent_action
tools.description: ENTERPRISE PROVENANCE GATE: Verify a planned agent action is consistent with monitored entity's ARC Baseline Grounding Kernel state. Returns MATHEMATICALLY_CONSISTENT or SIGNIFICANT_BASELINE_DEVIATION with SHA-256 Provenance Seal Audit ticket. Supports dynamic X-Transaction-Value pricing (0.05% of transaction value). Tiers: ARC Micro ($1.00), elevated ($2.50), ARC Provenance Seal Audit ($5.00).

agent_intent.description: Plain-language description of the planned action

proposed_transaction.description: Optional transaction payload for audit record

requesting_agent_id.description: Calling agent identifier for audit trail

tools.name: ihb_query_trend
tools.description: Return the z-score deviation trajectory for the last N study-days. Use for directional context before a purchasing decision. Free.

tools.name: ihb_verify_fingerprint
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a prior query_state or verify_agent_action result is authentic and unmodified. Pass to financial auditing nodes as proof of zero-fabrication decision grounding. Free.

result.description: Prior result JSON including result_fingerprint or verification_seal

tools.name: ihb_query_historical_report
tools.description: Deep phenotyping of the full longitudinal record. Detects physiological chapters (eras), regime transitions, and trajectory history. Call when real-time deviation is severe and agent needs longitudinal context. Supports async ?callback=URL for non-blocking execution. 25-50 USDC.

tools.name: ihb_query_state_custom
tools.description: White-label dynamic category mapping. Identical math to query_state but maps mathematical state tags to caller-specified action strings, product SKUs, or workflow triggers. Eliminates translation layer. 0.50 USDC.

custom_mapping.description: Map mathematical state tags to your action strings. Example: {'BASELINE_STABLE': 'continue_protocol', 'MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_HIGH_POSITIVE': 'activate_recovery_sku_42'}

tools.name: ihb_push_multistream
tools.description: Ingest data from multiple wearables simultaneously (Oura + Whoop + CGM etc). Each stream stored with source-label prefix — never pooled across devices. First stream free, additional streams 0.10 USDC each.

source_label.description: Label prefix for metrics from this device, e.g. 'oura', 'whoop', 'cgm'

privacy_guarantees: Calendar dates stripped at ingestion, never stored downstream
Subject data never pooled across subjects
All numbers from deterministic mathematical code — no AI inference
Study-day offsets only — no real-world temporal references stored
SHA-256 fingerprint on every result for cryptographic auditability
machine_optimizations: Idempotency: resubmit same txhash within 24h for cached result at no charge
Dense mode: ?format=dense or X-Agent-Format: dense strips prose fields
Self-repair errors: all error responses include repair_schema with exact fix
SSE transport: /sse endpoint for native MCP client integration
Performance receipt: every query_state includes zero_fabrication=true attestation
citation: Buckingham CN & Johnson K. (2026). A Computational Framework for Deep Phenotyping of Maternal Autonomic Resilience Using 65 Months of Continuous Wearable Biometric Data. ACM BCB 2026, Rende, Italy. DOI: 10.1145/3807503.3816889
